out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the END OF COOK LINE being used TEMPORARILY STORE FROZEN FOODS.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC RELOCATED FOODS TO FREEZER DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASH SINKS ARE USED FOR HANDWASHING ONLY. EMPLOYEES TRAINING AND COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: Receiving Temperature, Refrigerated Foods
violations.observation: The following refrigerated food item(s) is received at inadequate temperatures: BEEF BROTH AT 81F
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated time/temperature control for safety food shall be at a temperature of 41F or below when received. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE REFRIGERATED FOODS ARE RECEIVED AT 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: FRIED EGGS AT 89F (4 HOURS) STACKED IN COVERED CONTAINER IN AVANTCO 2 DOOR FLAT TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE USE PROPER COOLING METHODS TO COOL FOODS FROM 135F TO 70F IN 2 HOURS AND TO A FURTHER 41F WITHIN A TOTAL OF 6 HOURS.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: FRIED EGGS AT 89F (4 HOURS) STACKED IN COVERED CONTAINER IN AVANTCO 2 DOOR FLAT TOP.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCARD FOODS DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE USE SINGLE LAYERS, SHALLOW PANS IN REFRIGERATOR OR FREEZER TO RAPIDLY COOL FOODS WITHIN THE PROPER COOLING PARAMETERS. DO NOT COVER OR STACKED FOODS UNTIL COOLED TO 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: WORKING CONTAINERS OF OILS, WATER, RICE WINE, SALT, SUGAR, SPICES, ETC., NEAR COOK LINE AND COUNTER.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO APPLY LABLES DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor: BEVERAGES STORED DIRECTLY ON FLOOR IN BACK HALLWAY AND DINING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS TO ELEVATE FOODS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY NEXT INSPECTION.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: UTENSILS STORED IN WATER AT 89F NEAR COOK LINE.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REMOVED UTENSILS FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equip/Utensils, Durable under Normal Use
violations.observation: The following equipment is not designed and constructed to be durable: XZ-M500 AUTOMATIC INTELLIGENT NOODLE MACHINE DOES NOT APPEAR TO BE NSF APPROVED OR ANSI EQUIVALENT.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment and utensils shall be designed and constructed to be durable and to retain their characteristic qualities under normal use conditions. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DISCONTINUE USE OF EQUIPMENT FOR FOOD PREPARATION AT ESTABLISHMENT. PLEASE PROVIDE ONLY NSF APPROVED OR ANSI EQUIVALENT EQUIPMENT FOR USE IN ESTABLISHMENT.
